newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Seller interest was light at bids of $103.00-$104.00 per cwt as many were pricing cattle at $106.00-$107.00. Latest established price level was mostly $104.00 on last Thursday.
Dressed Basis Steers - Few loads Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 104.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Few loads Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 104.00.
Trading on slaughter steers and heifers were at a standstill Monday. Buyer inquiry fair.
Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - 500 Last Week - None Last Year - 100 For week - 4,800 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 500 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 4,400
